subject: Chevalier Theater Management Agreement
overview: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and city officials announced a long-term management agreement with promoter Bill Blumenreich for the Chevalier Theatre. The presentation outlined the terms of the agreement and concluded with the signing of the contract.

items.title: Chevalier Theatre Agreement Announcement
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke announced a partnership with Bill Blumenreich spanning four five-year terms, including a one-dollar per ticket restoration fund contribution, Medford hiring priorities, and continued accommodation for the Boys and Girls Club.

items.title: Remarks from Chevalier Commission
items.summary: Chevalier Commission Chair John Costas recognized long-time contributors to the venue's preservation and praised the committee for securing a professional theater management partner.

items.title: Promoter Remarks and Contract Signing
items.summary: Bill Blumenreich outlined plans to buy and book major entertainment acts directly for the Chevalier Theatre before joining the mayor to sign the management contract.
